categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Hangxin Aviation Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two main business segments: equipment development and support, including airborne equipment development, testing equipment development, aircraft modification, big data, and sensor businesses; and aviation maintenance and services, covering component repair, whole aircraft maintenance (base maintenance, line maintenance, interior modification, painting), and aviation asset management. The company also engages in VR/AR applications for aviation training and maintenance support.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as flight parameter and voice recording systems, comprehensive data acquisition and processing systems, helicopter usage monitoring systems (HUMS), equipment health management (PHM), and engine health management (EHM). It employs synthetic instrument technology based on aviation applications, ATML and IEEE standards for fault diagnosis, modular hardware platform design, and open architecture for automatic test equipment (ATE). The firm also develops high-temperature vibration sensors and radiation-resistant sensors for aviation and industrial applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic aircraft assembly units and aircraft operators, OEMs like Boeing and Airbus, and various airlines primarily in China, Southeast Asia, Europe, Middle East, and North Africa. The company serves civil aviation, general aviation, and low-altitude economy sectors, providing products and services for helicopters, fixed-wing aircraft, unmanned aerial vehicles, and aviation asset management.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with regional coverage in East China, North China, South China, Northeast, Southwest, Northwest, and Central China. Internationally, it has significant presence in Europe, Africa, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East through subsidiaries and acquisitions, including operations in Estonia, UK, Ireland, Malaysia, Netherlands, Germany, Poland, USA, Singapore, Zambia, Tanzania, Uganda, and Denmark.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangzhou Hangxin Aviation Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the aviation supply chain. It is involved in the research, development, and manufacturing of airborne and testing equipment (midstream), as well as providing comprehensive aviation maintenance, repair, overhaul (MRO) services, aircraft modification, and asset management (downstream).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on advancing health monitoring and intelligent maintenance systems, expanding comprehensive integrated technologies, and developing new-generation flight parameter and data acquisition systems. It emphasizes breakthroughs in helicopter safety and comprehensive support systems, engine health management, unmanned aerial vehicle equipment, and VR/AR applications for aviation training. R&D efforts also target expanding automatic test equipment capabilities, fault diagnosis software, and aviation big data analytics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of aviation equipment and testing devices, project-based research funding, and fees from aviation maintenance and repair services. Additional income streams include aircraft modification services, aviation asset leasing and sales, and software and data service products. The company operates on a direct sales model with a focus on long-term contracts and strategic partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic provider in flight parameter recording systems and helicopter monitoring systems, holding a significant market share with core intellectual property. It is among the earliest and largest domestic developers of automatic test equipment with a dominant market position. In aviation maintenance, it is certified by CAAC, FAA, and EASA, recognized as an authorized maintenance provider for Boeing and Airbus, and holds a strong competitive position among independent third-party MRO providers in China and overseas markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.7 billion, representing a 7.87% increase year-over-year. However, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 95.38 million, a significant decline due to increased bad debt provisions and other factors. The company has total assets of about RMB 2.36 billion and net assets of RMB 752 million. Despite profitability challenges, the company shows steady revenue growth and expanding international operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive aviation technology services aimed at ensuring flight safety, integrating advanced health monitoring and intelligent maintenance systems. Its products are characterized by high reliability, broad compatibility, and proprietary core technologies. The firm offers a full aviation service chain from equipment development to global maintenance and asset management, supported by strong R&D capabilities and strategic partnerships with OEMs, providing customers with integrated, innovative, and cost-effective aviation solutions.
